summary: Exact clean commit 87de899 is locally release-ready. REQ-001 through REQ-009 are proven by source audit, focused tests, workflow lint, and parser checks. REQ-010 remains the explicitly post-merge live acceptance gate: automatic v0.6.13 publication and absence of v0.6.14 must be observed without manual release actions.

REQ-010 residual/live gate: after merge, observe automatic CI/coordinator/verifier/publisher success, public v0.6.13 source ad52dfc and digests, no v0.6.14 tag/release, and no manual tag/dispatch/release action; record on issue #91.
